summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Enhanced Gantt Chart features. All 11 features tested and working correctly: zoom controls, toggle switches (Dependencies/Critical Path/Baseline), dependency arrows (SVG paths), critical path calculation with red highlighting, baseline bars with dashed outline, drag-and-drop task rescheduling with API integration, today line indicator, weekend highlighting, task statistics, click-to-open task modal, and legend with all symbols.
passed_tests: Enhanced Gantt Chart renders with data-testid='gantt-chart-enhanced'
Zoom controls (+/- buttons) work - tested 75%, 100%, 125% zoom levels
Dependencies toggle switch shows/hides SVG dependency arrows
Critical Path toggle switch shows/hides red critical path indicators
Baseline toggle switch shows/hides dashed outline baseline bars
Dependency arrows render as curved SVG paths between dependent tasks
Critical path calculation highlights tasks on longest path with red ring and 'Critical' badge
Baseline bars show original planned dates (simulated as 2 days earlier) with dashed outline
Drag-and-drop task bars successfully reschedules tasks and calls updateTask API
Toast notification 'Task dates updated' appears after successful drag-drop
Today line indicator (vertical black line) shows current date
Weekend highlighting (shaded columns) visible for Sat/Sun
Task statistics show Total Tasks, Completed, Critical, Blocked counts
Click on task bar opens task detail modal with correct task data
Click on task name in left column opens task detail modal
Legend shows status colors (Todo, In Progress, Review, Done)
Legend shows priority indicators (Urgent, High, Medium, Low)
Legend shows Critical Path symbol when toggle is ON
Legend shows Baseline symbol when toggle is ON
Legend shows Dependency arrow symbol when toggle is ON
Critical path recalculates dynamically when tasks are moved
